# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Use **GitHub's private vulnerability reporting** on the affected repository
(Security → Report a vulnerability) — that channel is private to the
maintainer and is the preferred route.

If that isn't available on a given repository, email **lumen@lumennode.uk**.

Expect an acknowledgement within about a week. These are solo-maintained
projects, not funded products — there is no formal SLA and no bounty
program, but reports are read and acted on.

## Scope

This is the account-wide default policy, used by any repository under this
account that doesn't define its own `SECURITY.md`. If a repository has its
own security policy, that one applies instead.

## Supported versions

Unless a repository states otherwise, only its default branch is supported.
There is no backport policy.
